literal: However small even, good things let one listen; that much even, excellent greatness it will give.
translation: Let one listen to good things, however small they may be; even that much will bring them excellent greatness.
modern: எவ்வளவு சிறியதாக இருந்தாலும் நல்ல விஷயங்களைக் கேட்க வேண்டும்; அது அந்த அளவிற்கு நிறைந்த பெருமையைத் தரும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the value of listening to good and virtuous teachings. The word 'எனைத்தானும்' suggests that no piece of good advice is too insignificant to hear. 'அனைத்தானும்' promises a proportional reward, showing that every little bit of wisdom accumulates. Ultimately, such listening yields 'ஆன்ற பெருமை', elevating the listener's character and dignity.
